content.text:
Fixed `ModelAdmin.lookup_allowed()` in `django/contrib/admin/options.py`.

Root cause: the "concrete inheritance" shortcut skipped appending a relation part whenever the next field was in the previous relation's `target_fields`. For a `OneToOneField` used as a primary key (e.g. `Restaurant.place`), the target field of the preceding FK is that pk field, so `place` was wrongly dropped from `relation_parts`, collapsing `restaurant__place__country` to `restaurant__country`, which isn't in `list_filter` — raising `DisallowedModelAdminLookup`.

Fix: only take the shortcut when the previous field is an actual concrete-inheritance parent link, i.e. guard the condition with `not getattr(prev_field.remote_field, "parent_link", False)`. The `getattr` default keeps reverse OneToOne relations (whose `remote_field` is the forward field without a `parent_link` attribute) working.

Verification: `scoped_tests` public regression selection (`modeladmin`) passes — 162 tests, OK.
